title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in English, Part 2 (CEFR A0–A1)
dek: Part 2 of the ultimate beginner guide to high-frequency English verbs (A0–A1): do/make, speak/talk/say/tell, look/watch/see, listen/hear, must/have to, take/give/get, live, wait, understand, and ask/answer.

blocks.text: Welcome to Part 2 of our A0–A1 English Verbs Guide! In this December Issue edition, we cover 10 core action, perception, and communication verbs.

items: **1. Do / Make:** Activity vs Creation (*I do homework* vs *I make coffee*).
**2. Speak / Talk / Say / Tell:** Communication nuances (*I speak English*, *Tell me*).
**3. Look / Watch / See:** Visual perception & attention (*Watch a film*, *I see a house*).
**4. Listen / Hear:** Auditory attention vs involuntary hearing (*Listen to music*, *I hear a sound*).
**5. Must / Have to:** Expressing obligation and necessity (*I must go*, *I have to work*).
**6. Take / Give / Get:** Exchange & receiving (*Take a coffee*, *Give me a book*, *Get a present*).
**7. Live:** Residence & life (*I live in London*).
**8. Wait:** Patience & expectation (*Wait for the bus*).
**10. Ask / Answer & Want / Would like:** Inquiries and polite requests (*Ask a question*, *I would like a tea*).
